.coachmark {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-block;
    cursor: pointer;

    .coachmark .coachmarktext {
        visibility: hidden;
        width: 250px;
        background-color: royalblue;
        color: white;
        text-align: left;
        border-radius: 4px;
        padding: 12px 10px;
        position: absolute;
        z-index: 1;
        /* bottom: 100%;
        left: 50%; */
        margin-left: -125px;
    }

        .coachmark .coachmarktext::after {
            content: "";
            position: absolute;
            top: 100%;
            left: 50%;
            margin-left: -5px;
            border-width: 5px;
            border-style: solid;
            border-color: royalblue transparent transparent transparent;
        }

    .coachmark .show {
        visibility: visible;
        -webkit-animation: fadeIn 1s;
        animation: fadeIn 1s;
    }

@-webkit-keyframes fadeIn {
    from {
        opacity: 0;
    }

    to {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}
